pipeline_contract.node_identity: canonical Prompt ID; exactly one node per live Prompt Kit record
pipeline_contract.edge_model: one prompt-pair edge with multiple ordered relationship channels
pipeline_contract.embedding_seam: replaceable provider adapter; Phase A CI defaults to deterministic local hashing vectors
pipeline_contract.clustering: deterministic PCA -> sklearn.cluster.HDBSCAN with legitimate outliers
pipeline_contract.cluster_identity: persistent cluster_id reconciled against previous accepted topology; membership_fingerprint_sha256 records exact current membership
pipeline_contract.opportunity_intelligence: deterministic advisory scoring only; never mutates registry truth

forbidden_scope: live browser telemetry or background event collection
proof_ceiling: Phase A repository/runtime proof may establish live-registry graph generation, HDBSCAN clustering, persistent cluster reconciliation, advisory opportunities, canonical artifact parity, and repeat/shuffle determinism. It does not establish Phase B 3D projection or Phase C viewer/live behavior proof.
